info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to churn, to think, to meditate, to ponder

examples: 'sannipAtAvaDUtESca pramATonmaTanEstaTA' (hari॰2.30.32). pramATo (mallasTa) BUmO pAtanam. BArate (virAwa॰13.27) apyayaM SlokaH paWyate.
tatra nIlakaRWa eva vivfRoti- nipAtya pezaRaM BUmO pramATa iti kaTyate. yattUtTAyANgamaTanaM tadunmaTanamucyate.
'prayojayati conmATaM nityamastaM gate ravO' (BA0 SAM0 138.23).  unmATaH kUwayantraM paSumfgapakzibanDanam.
